comment: Real go test -race -json output from Go 1.27.1, with paths shortened to /src and timestamps dropped. Each case names its stdout (<name>.jsonl) and optional stderr (<name>.stderr), the exit code, and what go-test must make of it: a pass, one finding per failed package whose message contains 'contains' and not 'omits', or an error containing 'contains'. runner/checks_test.go and internal/verify/gotest_test.go both read this table, so the two copies of testFindings cannot drift apart.

cases.name: build
cases.contains: go test could not build example.com/test-build: # example.com/test-build [example.com/test-build.test]

cases.name: mixed
cases.contains: go test could not build example.com/mixed/broken
